excerpt.classification: HARNESS DEFECT in the Exp14 shape gate: the absolute attention tolerance (5e-3, borrowed from the single 70-token case of test_rabit_kv2_stage3c.py) is not valid at very short contexts, where the fp32-reference vs BF16-output difference is larger; the accepted Llama fast path (positive control) fails it identically. Not a Model-B, RABIT or kernel correctness failure: zero page-byte / state mismatches, and the runtime state matches the independent reference state exactly in attention error. The magnitude attribution to BF16 output rounding is a hypothesis, not yet verified.
